chunks: And Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:

Regarding a man whom a group instructed to purchase a camel for them with silver, and that they would give him an increase above that for deferred payment: so he purchased a camel for them, and one of them was with him, and he عليه السلام forbade him from taking from them more than his silver on account of deferred payment.

key_terms.بَعِيرًا: a camel being purchased in the transaction
key_terms.بِوَرِقٍ: with silver currency as the principal amount
key_terms.فَمَنَعَهُ: he forbade him, indicating legal prohibition in this case
key_terms.فَوْقَ: an added amount above the original sum

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to charge extra on a sale only because payment is deferred?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a purchase arrangement in which an additional amount was to be taken in exchange for delay in payment. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام forbids taking an increase above the principal silver amount merely because of deferment, indicating the impermissibility of such a transaction.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4023 - Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said

regarding a man who was instructed by a group to buy a camel for them with silver and to charge them extra for deferred payment. He bought the camel for them, and one of them was with him.
Imam (as) prohibited him from taking more than the silver amount for the deferred payment.
